about: The re-import (WP-5.3) by m3a-import 1: each clip's choice between its re-import and its migrated version, with why; both fits (mean, worst mm against the source); both QA verdicts; the sensor metrics that moved ([migrated, re-import]); the hands' mean error against the capture ([migrated, re-import] mm; props: over the clips that hold something); what the catalog skips; the clips the migrated set had that are gone.

skipped.name: WildLegs_Walk
skipped.why: the format can't hold it (WP-5.3): kicked up behind, the right foot turns upside down, which a foot's pitch and turn can't say, so even as its own key the toe misses by 546 mm
